title: feat(plugin-form): one divider-row rule, group semantics on every arm, and the modal collapse pair (objectui#9849 step two)
body:
Fixes #9849
Clause-②: yes

Step two of director ruling `5749155880` on objectui#9849 (letter E, maintainer 「同意」). Step one landed as objectui#10236 (`58d65c50d`). This PR delivers items 1-3 and the modal collapse pair that the step-one ACCEPT and release assigned to step two (`5813521252`, `5814745907`). Nothing from the ruling is left on the card, so line 1 is `Fixes`.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb` (seat `domain:ui#3`, claim `5817014539`).

## What changed

`packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts`
- `SectionDividerGate` is deleted, along with the four-way gate parameter of `projectSectionDivider`.
- New `sectionDrawsDividerRow(title, description)` is THE one row rule (item 2): the visible row exists iff `title || description`. Each of the default, modal and drawer arms asks it to decide two things: whether a row is drawn, and whether a collapse control has a place to live.
- `projectSectionDivider(source)` applies the rule the same way for the default, modal and drawer arms (item 1; SplitForm and TabbedForm build their own rows, see Acceptance notes):
  - `title || description`: one row carrying the label, blurb, ADR-0089 `visibleWhen`, the objectui#6236 membership claim and the collapse pair. With `description` alone this is the blurb-only row: no heading span, only the blurb, which is objectui#9835's shape.
  - Neither, but a `visibleWhen`: a CHROME-LESS gate row (`__section_gate_KEY`, no label, no description). `SectionDivider` renders it as nothing. It exists only to carry the predicate and the claim, so a headingless group is never un-gated. This is the same shape `TabbedForm` already emits for a degraded single-section form.
  - Neither, and no predicate: no row at all.
- `resolveSectionCollapse` no longer takes a per-arm `hostsControl`. It derives that from the one row rule, from the `title` and `description` the arm hands it. A section that declares `collapsible` / `collapsed` but yields neither resolves OPEN, with no control, and fires the item-3 diagnostic.
- New `headinglessCollapseWarning`. It is a once-per-section `console.warn` whose first sentence is the ruling's wording verbatim: 「collapsible section has no heading or description to carry its control」. This is the channel the package already uses for renderer-side author mistakes (`warnSectionMemberExcludedByFields` in `sectionFields.ts`). `resetHeadinglessCollapseWarnings` exists for the pins only. `fieldGroups.ts` is not re-exported by the package barrel.

`ObjectForm.tsx`
- The default arm calls the one rule. The modal map now copies `collapsible` / `collapsed`, which the spec declares on `sections[]` and which `ObjectFormSection` already types.

`ModalForm.tsx`
- `ModalFormSectionConfig` gains `collapsible` / `collapsed`. This type reaches the published surface through `ModalFormSchema.sections`, which is why this PR carries `Clause-②: yes`.
- Both stacked pushes (explicit `sections` and derived `fieldGroups`) now resolve the pair through `resolveSectionCollapse`, keep per-section live state, and hide a collapsed group's fields only while its row carries the control.
- With `contentLayout: 'tabbed'` and more than one explicit section, the modal draws tabs, which do not collapse; that path is untouched and never reports. A single-section tabbed modal (the `groups.length > 1` guard) and any derived-`fieldGroups` modal render stacked, so they honour the pair and can report.

`DrawerForm.tsx`
- Both pushes call the one rule. The explicit push used to draw a row for EVERY section (the old `always` gate). It now follows `title || description`, plus the gate row for a headingless predicate.

## Behaviour, per headingless member

| member | default arm before | modal explicit before | drawer explicit before | default / modal / drawer now |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` only | blurb-only row, carrying no predicate, claim or collapse | full row | full row | blurb-only row carrying predicate, claim and collapse |
| neither, with `visibleWhen` | no row, so the group was UN-gated | no row, UN-gated | an empty-label row, gated | chrome-less gate row, gated |
| neither, with `collapsed: true` | open, silent | open (modal ignored the pair) | open, silent (after step one) | open, plus the diagnostic |
| `description` and `collapsed: true` | open, and `collapsed` was ignored | open (modal ignored the pair) | closed, control on the blurb row | closed, control on the blurb row |

Card hypothesis 2 was measured. The card's original defect is already gone on `origin/main` (objectui#9974): the modal's derived push drops `description` and gates on `title` only. At base `4ab4f1ba211a`, `sectionDividerProjection-9849` block 1, row 4 (modal derived blurb) was green: `Tests 61 passed (61)` over the four neighbouring pins. It stays green here.

## Pins

- `drawerFormSectionDescription-9834` row 5 is RE-PINNED to the new semantics. The headingless blurb row renders the blurb with no heading. Under a denying predicate scope it hides the blurb AND the member; under an admitting scope it shows both.
- `collapseResolution-9849`: the modal rows FLIP on purpose. The step-one reading block ("honours neither member") is deleted. The two modal explicit routes (direct, and through ObjectForm's modal map) and the modal derived route join the full resolution matrix. The headingless trap rows now cover all five explicit routes and assert the diagnostic. The drawer-only blurb-row test now runs on every explicit route.
- `objectFormSectionMembers-8071` rows 8 and 9 FLIP. They pinned letter B's 「the blurb-only row carries nothing else」, and ruling E item 1 refused exactly that. The blurb-only row is now the collapse control (row 8), and it gates its group by the predicate (row 9, with both scopes).
- `sectionDividerProjection-9849` block 3 is rewritten. The residual it recorded as readings is gone, so it now pins the one rule on the three explicit arms: blurb-only row; no visible row; and the predicate gating through the blurb row and through the chrome-less gate row, each under both scopes.
- NEW `headinglessCollapseDiagnostic-9849`, the diagnostic pin. Row 1 checks the wording against the ruling. Row 2 checks all five explicit routes: each reports once, names its arm and object, draws no control and keeps its fields. Row 3 is the absence controls: a heading, a blurb, or no pair reports nothing. Row 4 checks the dedupe. The derived routes are not mounted, because a declared group always yields a heading from its key (block 4 of the projection pin).

## Ablation (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from ../objectstack, WRAP mode, anchor hit exactly once, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`, plus an outer trap)

Corpus: the five pin files above, 99 tests. No `dist/` is involved: the pins import plugin-form from `src`.
- Leg 1, the chrome-less gate row removed: `Tests 3 failed | 96 passed (99)`. These are exactly the three 「through a chrome-less gate row」 rows. Predicted 3.
- Leg 2, the control hosted on a heading only: `Tests 11 failed | 88 passed (99)`. That is 8071 row 8, five blurb-row routes, and five diagnostic absence rows (a blurb-only member warns wrongly). Predicted 11.
- Leg 3, the diagnostic call deleted: `Tests 16 failed | 83 passed (99)`. That is ten trap rows, five diagnostic route rows and the dedupe row. Predicted 16.
- Leg 4, ObjectForm's modal map stops copying the pair: `Tests 8 failed | 91 passed (99)`, every modal-map row. Predicted 7. I missed the modal-map blurb-row test, so the observed count is one higher.
- ⚠️ The first leg-4 attempt was a no-op. The tool refused it because the replacement was a substring of the anchor, so its count could not rise. It was re-run with a rising replacement. The numbers above come from the re-run.
- Every leg printed `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD empty`. The final state proof matched HEAD for `fieldGroups.ts` (`39d2f2fc8281`) and `ObjectForm.tsx` (`25999aa16554`). Those readings are from before the last commit, which only changes the modal-map line of `ObjectForm.tsx` (an `as any` cast dropped).

## Verification at `5db96e9`

- Run under the shared verify lock: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, then `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` gave `Test Files 115 passed (115)` and `Tests 1153 passed | 1 skipped (1154)`. The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new or edited 9849 pin files.
- Dependency closure built first: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' run build` gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Lint is a declared narrowing to the 9 changed ts/tsx files. The population is `eslint.config.js` `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`. The `--format json` count is 9 files with 0 errors. Invariance: `eslint.config.js` has 0 `projectService` / `parserOptions.project` hits, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. Warning counts on the three edited arms equal BASE: ObjectForm 60, ModalForm 20, DrawerForm 22, fieldGroups 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Gates, each exit captured by redirect. All exited 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-types`, `check:docs-route-closure`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check-changeset-presence` (names `.changeset/9849-section-gate-rule-e.md`), `check-changeset-no-major`, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` exited 2 (PRECONDITION NOT MET, needs a 34-package scoped build). The docs section this PR adds holds no code fence, so it adds nothing that gate reads. CI owns it.

## Acceptance notes (not in this PR)

- ModalForm's first-load editable window, objectui#10190's shape: seat 2's cross-seat note `5815429411`. Named out of scope by the dispatch and not touched here. No carrier: nobody has taken it.
- SplitForm and TabbedForm still build their own section rows outside `projectSectionDivider`. They are outside this card's file surface. SplitForm reads neither collapse member.
- `FormSectionContainer` in `FormSection.tsx` has the same pair shape at prop level. Its only caller, WizardForm, passes neither. Already recorded by step one.

## Changeset

`.changeset/9849-section-gate-rule-e.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` `minor`: a published renderer behaviour change plus two new members on an exported type. Docs: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` gains 「Section rows: heading, blurb and collapse」.
